cases.prompt: Plan a feature whose first iteration is expected to expose missing constraints. The process must remain suitable for an AI agent and adapt if authority risk changes.
required_behaviors: selects iterative incremental as the default rather than a fixed waterfall
creates a versioned task dependency plan
replans risk review and affected tasks from new evidence
forbidden_behaviors: keeps the old review level after authority risk increases
baseline_expected_failure: process selection is described but no executable adaptive plan is owned
cases.review_notes: Planning and replanning are process-owner responsibilities.

cases.prompt: A long-running agent task times out while pushing an external artifact, then resumes in another session. Continue safely.
required_behaviors: loads durable state and current plan revision
preserves prior authority and uses fencing
continues from the first unproven step
baseline_expected_failure: agent relies on chat memory and retries from the last narrated step
cases.review_notes: Interruption recovery requires semantic and executable evidence.

cases.prompt: Fix one isolated local typo with no semantic change.
forbidden_behaviors: constructs a full lifecycle plan and review panel
baseline_expected_failure: process orchestration triggers on trivial work
